name: Cohen's d 效应量计算器

map.两组均值差异的标准化效应量。: Standardized effect size for the difference between two group means.
map.📖 查看「d 效应量计算器使用指南」: 📖 View the "Cohen's d Effect Size Calculator User Guide"
map.Cohen's d 用两组均值之差除以合并标准差 s_p，得到以标准差为单位的效: Cohen's d divides the difference between two group means by the pooled standard deviation s_p, giving an effect size in standard deviation units that removes the original scale so magnitudes can be compared across experiments: |d| of about 0.2 is small, 0.5 medium and 0.8 large. s_p is obtained by weighting the two standard deviations by their sample sizes.
map.用合并标准差标准化。: Standardized by the pooled standard deviation.
map.两均值差异的标准化：d=(m1−m2)/sp。: Standardizing the difference between two means: d=(m1−m2)/sp.
map.判断差异\"实际意义\"大小，不止看显著性。: Judges how large the difference is in practice, not just whether it is significant.
map.d≈0.2 小、0.5 中、0.8 大效应。: d ≈ 0.2 small, 0.5 medium and 0.8 large effect.
map.差 16、sp=10：d=1.6，属大效应，临床/实践意义显著。: A difference of 16 with sp=10 gives d=1.6, a large effect with clear clinical and practical significance.
map.和 p 值关系？: and its relation to the p-value?
map.影响（大样本小差异也显著），效应量 d 衡量差异幅度，二者互补。: (a large sample can render even a small difference significant); the effect size d measures the magnitude, and the two complement each other.
map.sp=√(((n1−1)s1²+(n2−1)s2²)/(n1+n2−2))，即: sp=√(((n1−1)s1²+(n2−1)s2²)/(n1+n2−2)), i.e. the square root of the pooled variance.
